evals.prompt: Plan three X thread directions for a tiny desk toy that helps builders ship stuck tasks. The user will approve one from Telegram, so every direction must be judgeable from the message.
evals.expected_output: Applies the X Thread Todo List guardrails; presents each direction with a concrete hook, reader promise, and tweet-by-tweet progression; keeps evidence, payoff, and CTA explicit; makes the review message self-contained; and leaves publication approval required.
assertions: Applies the X Thread Todo List guardrails before preparing the review request
Presents each direction with a concrete hook and reader value promise
Includes tweet-by-tweet progression rather than only high-level premises
Shows evidence, payoff, and a stage-appropriate CTA
Makes the review message self-contained enough to judge without a local path
Keeps publishing and scheduling outside scope unless explicitly approved

farplane.title: X thread directions contain concrete tweet stacks
farplane.notes: Regression for review requests that offered vague X-thread premises instead of a decision-ready copy artifact.
